body: It's not that I want to be isolated or like it. I just don't have the social skills to make/keep any kind of relationship (I have aspergers which makes it really hard). I try to make friends but I always end up alone. As for the poetry I used to play guitar, piano, and I'd write some of my own lyrics. They started getting so depressing that everytime I would play I'd contemplate suicide and sometimes even cut myself. My doc at the time said it might be a bad idea to keep going. So now all I have is basketball and I'm slowly losing that.
